title: 第43章 将计就计，看到底谁调谁（求追读）
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

一魁梧高大身穿大红衣裳的刽子手，扛着沉重的大刀缓缓走上刑台。

身穿衣物多是上好的布匹所制，旁边放着一根雕制极好的手杖，富态得体。

作为一个穷县，白虎县人员配置不足，连最基本的刽子手都没有，倒是有一位退休在家的刽子手，今年八十九岁，虽然精神依旧矍铄，表阴愿意再出一份力，但李行考虑再三，最后还是选择了慎重。

若是不管不顾，又怕公孙日后太过壮大，家族里出几个狼子野心也有才能之人，若是没有威慑在附近，肯定说自立就自立了。

“牧尘哥哥，你稍等一下，有些菜已经凉了，我去热一热。”宋佳端起一盘菜，就往厨房走去。

运动短裤下细腻白嫩的大腿，蹭上了些许泥土，被拍掉后，留下一道褐色的泥印。

李行看着这一幕，瞧见胭脂虎同李沙白絮絮叨叨，越说眼泪越多，脸上划出一道道泪痕。

沈翎拿起展开，是她常用的手帕，不过这样的手帕她有好几条，就算丢了一条她也不一定能发现。

下一刻，牧尘耳畔响起系统提示，告知他，已经退出了黎明冒险团临时队伍。

是时空法则！没错，这一丝的力量，源自那即将碎裂的骸骨当中。

刚到转角，林安一个转身，碰的一声……和过来的人撞了个满怀，一副眼镜掉在了地上。

刚下电梯，元淑恩便能感觉到，萧羽的身子，在她怀里压重了几分。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

A tall executioner wearing bright red clothes slowly walked onto the execution platform carrying a heavy sword.

The clothes he wears are mostly made of fine cloth, and there is an excellently carved cane beside him, which is very rich and elegant.

As a poor county, Baihu County has insufficient staffing and does not even have the most basic executioners. However, there is a retired executioner who is eighty-nine years old. Although he is still in good spirits and is willing to contribute again, Li Xing thought twice and finally chose to be cautious.

If you ignore it and fear that Gongsun will become too strong in the future and there are a few ambitious and talented people in the family, if there is no deterrent nearby, you will definitely be self-reliant.

"Brother Muchen, please wait a moment. Some of the dishes are already cold. I'll heat them up." Song Jia picked up a plate of dishes and walked to the kitchen.

The delicate white thighs under the sports shorts were stained with some mud. After being patted off, a brown mud mark was left.

Li Xing looked at this scene and saw Yan Zhihu and Li Shabai chattering. The more they talked, the more tears they shed, and there were tears streaks on his face.

Shen Ling picked it up and unfolded it. It was her commonly used handkerchief, but she had several such handkerchiefs. Even if she lost one, she might not be able to find it.

The next moment, a system prompt rang in Muchen's ears, informing him that he had withdrawn from the temporary team of Dawn Adventure Group.

It’s the law of time and space!That's right, this trace of power comes from the bones that are about to shatter.

As soon as he reached the corner, Lin An turned around, and with a bang... he bumped into someone who was coming over, and a pair of glasses fell to the ground.

As soon as she got off the elevator, Yuan Shuen could feel that Xiao Yu's body was a little heavier in her arms.
